text:
elena: Thanks everyone — quick follow-ups from today's all-hands security Q&A. Can we get a concise checklist for: SOC2 scope & evidence timeline, ISO roadmap, KMS BYOK options + key rotation SLA, VPC private endpoints for Private customers, audit log retention/export for Dedicated and Private? Trying to compile asks for customers. /cc @pranav @tara @raj

pranav: TL;DR: SOC2 timeline Q4 for control remediation, evidence collection starts next week. We will publish an evidence matrix. ISO currently targeted for H1 next year. BYOK: customers can bring keys via KMS wrap or HSM; rotation policy we recommend 90 days but support configurable.

tara: For VPC: Private customers get privatelink + customer-managed subnets. Need to confirm whether Private supports cross-account peering — filing ticket.

raj: SOC2 evidence: we'll need map of who owns which artifacts (docs, runbooks, config, screenshots). I'll run an evidence intake on Monday. Office hours scheduled Wed 10am.

jin: For audit logs: default retention is 90 days for hosted, configurable to 365 for Dedicated/Private. Export pipeline to S3 exists. Example config:
```
redwoodctl logs export --target s3://company-bucket/redwood-audit --days 365 --format json
```

sam: Can we get a short public FAQ paragraph we can share with customers on BYOK and log export? I can draft if someone reviews.

security-bot: Docs: https://intranet.redwood.ai/security/compliance (policy draft), Ticket: #1254 created for VPC cross-account.

elena: Awesome. Action items: @raj to publish evidence intake form (due Mon EOD), @tara to confirm cross-account peering support + ticket eta (due Tue), @pranav to publish KMS/BYOK options doc (due Tue), @jin to add S3 export example to public docs (due Thu). Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

pranav: Noted. Will add short decision matrix for quantization/keys and SLAs.

tara: Filing follow-up infra PR and will ping here when merged. :thumbsup:

raj: Office hours invite sent. Adding checklist to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Compliance+Checklist

elena: Thanks team — keeping this thread pinned for customersafe followups.
